findings.text: non-blocking: compare_record_arms re-implements the paired percentile bootstrap inline (random.Random at :2602, sorted draws and the 0.025/0.975 index at :2608) instead of using imas_codex/discovery/base/evaluation.py:144 bootstrap_interval, whose scores_b plus statistic path already returns the paired mean-difference interval; a second implementation of a capability the repository owns will drift from the owner.

non-blocking: the fixture sets changed_incumbent True on exactly the two rows that are also incumbent_right, so `assert report.changed_right_incumbent == 2` also holds if benchmark.py:2524 drops its right_incumbent_total filter and counts every changed row; the drift figure the report publishes is therefore not guarded by a failing condition.

non-blocking: KIMI_COMMAND carries the literal `<B300-server>` placeholder and is published verbatim as .not_run[0].command, so the done_when's "the command that will run it" is a template no shell can run, and the subscription entry points at a --stage measure invocation that does not select an arm the report would add.

non-blocking: RecordBenchmarkRow accepts any non-empty blocker string and summarize_record_arm counts it verbatim, so the published .final.arms blocked_by_type for one-pass/local contains a one-letter key "e" beside three unrelated vocabularies (missing_bound_source, bound_source, generation-failure:...); the done_when's share-blocked-by-type table is bucketed on an unvalidated free-text vocabulary.

non-blocking: assert_controls_separate has no production caller - neither the evidence runner nor any imas_codex module calls it, the runner records "measuring": false instead - so the only refusal the module offers for a non-separating control is exercised by its own test and by nothing that runs.

non-blocking: the report publishes "ruling": "awaiting the lead's ruling" and the node ended complete, so the done_when clause "the ruling is recorded here" is unmet; the choice is presented with its figures, but no ruling exists in the record for a later node to read.

non-blocking: dependent_members selects members whose evidence quote sits only in the enclosing text (3 held-out members) but does not require the full arm to have got them right, so .final.controls.withheld compares 0/3 full against 0/3 withheld: the withheld control could not separate by construction and its failure says nothing about whether withholding the text matters.

item_verdicts.call_sites: three production call sites were verified in imas_codex/standard_names/advisory_benchmark.py (:228, :238, :319) for the renamed public cost helpers; the record-benchmark symbols have no package runtime caller outside the evidence runner.
